question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Feel the pinch

options.text: Be in an agitated state of mind

solution:
The correct answer is **'Face financial difficulties'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Feel the pinch'** is **'Face financial difficulties'.**
 
• **Feel the pinch:** experience hardship, especially financial. (कठिनाई का अनुभव, विशेष रूप से वित्तीय)
 
 
• *Example: Staff were beginning to **feel the pinch **as the dispute entered its third week. ***
 
 
 

Correct Answer:__** *Face financial difficulties.*
